topics.title: Faith and Belief
topics.description: Core belief: Islam and Iman, Allah, the unseen, the decree and following the Sunnah; not the Hereafter (see hereafter) nor acts of worship.

subtopics.title: Islam, Iman and Ihsan
subtopics.description: What Islam and faith are, their pillars and branches, how faith grows or weakens, and love of Allah and His Messenger as part of faith; not entering Islam (see becoming-muslim).

subtopics.title: Becoming Muslim
subtopics.description: Entering Islam, sincere or forced conversion, and what a new Muslim keeps or must do; not the pillars themselves (see pillars-of-faith).

subtopics.title: Oneness of Allah, Shirk and Superstition
subtopics.description: Worshipping Allah alone, warnings against shirk, kufr and idols, fortune-tellers and bad omens; not magic or the evil eye (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

subtopics.title: Allah's Names and Attributes
subtopics.description: Allah's names and attributes, His mercy, speech, knowledge and throne; not words of praise and dhikr (see remembrance).

subtopics.title: Divine Decree (Qadar)
subtopics.description: Predestination, what is written for each person, the creation of man in the womb and arguing about the decree; not trusting Allah as a practice (see trust-fear-hope).

subtopics.title: Angels, Jinn and Satan
subtopics.description: Angels, jinn, Satan and his whispering, and other unseen beings; not ruqyah, magic or the evil eye (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

subtopics.title: Hypocrisy and Apostasy
subtopics.description: Signs of hypocrites, leaving Islam and its ruling; not sins in general (see sins-and-major-sins).

subtopics.title: Following the Sunnah and Innovation
subtopics.description: Holding to the Qur'an and Sunnah, obeying the Messenger and avoiding innovation in religion; not how hadith are narrated (see narrating-hadith).

subtopics.title: Dreams and Visions
subtopics.description: True dreams, bad dreams and how dreams are interpreted; not sleep habits (see sleep).

subtopics.title: Magic, Omens and Fortune-Telling
subtopics.description: Sorcery, soothsayers, astrology, bad omens and amulets and their ruling; not treatment by ruqyah (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

topics.title: The Qur'an
topics.description: The Qur'an itself: its virtues, recitation, revelation and commentary; not recitation inside the prayer (see prayer-recitation).

subtopics.title: Virtues of the Qur'an and Surahs
subtopics.description: The reward of the Qur'an and of particular surahs and verses; not what a verse means (see tafsir).

subtopics.title: Reciting and Memorising the Qur'an
subtopics.description: How to recite, beautify, memorise, revise and complete the Qur'an outside the prayer; not recitation inside the prayer (see prayer-recitation).

subtopics.title: Prostration of Recitation
subtopics.description: The verses of prostration and prostrating when reciting or hearing them; not prostration as part of the prayer (see prayer-prostration).

subtopics.title: Commentary on Verses (Tafsir)
subtopics.description: Explanations and occasions of particular verses and surahs, including bare verse or surah headings; not the reward of reciting them (see virtues-of-surahs).

subtopics.title: Revelation and Compilation
subtopics.description: How revelation came, the modes of reading, abrogation and how the Qur'an was collected; not the Prophet's wider life (see seerah-events).

subtopics.title: Respect for the Mushaf
subtopics.description: Handling, carrying and honouring the written Qur'an; not recitation (see recitation-of-quran).

topics.title: Knowledge and Teaching
topics.description: Seeking, teaching and passing on religious knowledge; not reading the Qur'an (see quran).

subtopics.title: Seeking Knowledge
subtopics.description: The virtue of learning, the manners of students and scholars, and the loss of knowledge; not asking for a ruling (see religious-verdicts).

subtopics.title: Teaching and Preaching
subtopics.description: How to teach, admonish and remind people outside the Friday sermon; not the Friday khutbah (see friday-prayer).

subtopics.title: Asking Questions and Giving Rulings
subtopics.description: Asking scholars, giving fatwas, personal opinion and analogy, and asking too many questions; not judges settling disputes (see judges-and-testimony).

subtopics.title: Narrating and Writing Down Hadith
subtopics.description: Transmitting and writing down reports, lying about the Prophet and narrators' differences in wording; not learning in general (see seeking-knowledge); the report's own subject is tagged separately.

subtopics.title: Acting on Knowledge
subtopics.description: Practising what one knows, knowledge that does not benefit, and the learned who do not act.

subtopics.title: Scholars and Their Status
subtopics.description: The rank of scholars, their loss before the Hour, and respect for them.

subtopics.title: Manners of Asking and Learning
subtopics.description: How to ask questions, excessive or pointless questions, and the learner's manners.

topics.title: Purification
topics.description: Ritual cleanliness before worship; not hair, nails and grooming (see hair-and-grooming) nor washing the dead (see washing-and-shrouding).

subtopics.title: How to Perform Wudu
subtopics.description: The steps of wudu, washing each limb, its sunnahs and its virtue; not what breaks it (see ablution-breakers) nor wiping over socks (see wiping-footwear).

subtopics.title: What Breaks Wudu
subtopics.description: Things that do or do not break wudu (sleep, touching, camel meat, cooked food, bleeding) and doubt about whether one is still pure; not ghusl (see ghusl).

subtopics.title: Wiping over Socks and Turbans
subtopics.description: Wiping over leather socks, ordinary socks and turbans, and for how long; not washing the feet in wudu (see wudu).

subtopics.title: Ritual Bath (Ghusl)
subtopics.description: The full bath, janabah and when ghusl is required or recommended; not menstruation rulings (see menstruation).

subtopics.title: Dry Ablution (Tayammum)
subtopics.description: Purifying with earth when water is missing or harmful; not wudu with water (see wudu).

subtopics.title: Relieving Oneself
subtopics.description: Toilet manners, privacy, facing the qiblah, istinja and urine; not cleaning impurity off clothes (see water-and-impurities).

subtopics.title: Water, Vessels and Removing Impurity
subtopics.description: Which water purifies, vessels a dog licked, and cleaning urine, semen, blood and other filth from body and clothes; not what breaks wudu (see ablution-breakers).

subtopics.title: Menstruation and Postnatal Bleeding
subtopics.description: Haid, istihadah and nifas and what is allowed during them; not the divorce waiting period (see iddah-and-mourning).

subtopics.title: Siwak and Cleaning the Mouth
subtopics.description: Brushing the teeth with siwak and rinsing the mouth; not other grooming (see hair-and-grooming).

topics.title: Prayer: Times and How to Pray
topics.description: The five daily prayers: their times, the call, and how to pray them step by step; not congregation and mosques (see congregation-mosques) nor voluntary and special prayers (see special-prayers).

subtopics.title: Virtue and Duty of Prayer
subtopics.description: Why prayer matters, its reward, its obligation and the sin of leaving it; not the method (see prayer-opening).

subtopics.title: Prayer Times
subtopics.description: The time of each prayer, disliked times and delaying a prayer; not making up a missed prayer (see missed-prayers).

subtopics.title: Missed Prayers
subtopics.description: Making up prayers missed through sleep, forgetting or another cause; not ordinary prayer times (see prayer-times).

subtopics.title: Call to Prayer (Adhan and Iqamah)
subtopics.description: The adhan, iqamah, the mu'adhdhin and replying to the call; not prayer times (see prayer-times).

subtopics.title: Facing the Qiblah and the Sutrah
subtopics.description: Facing the qiblah, using a sutrah and passing in front of someone praying; not where one may pray (see prayer-places).

subtopics.title: Dress for Prayer
subtopics.description: Covering the body, footwear and arranging clothes or hair during prayer; not clothing in general (see clothing).

subtopics.title: Where One May Pray
subtopics.description: Places and surfaces where prayer is allowed or not, such as camel pens, graveyards and mats; not mosque manners (see mosques).

subtopics.title: Starting the Prayer
subtopics.description: The opening takbir, raising the hands and the opening supplications; not the recitation that follows (see prayer-recitation).

subtopics.title: Recitation in Prayer
subtopics.description: What to recite in each prayer, al-Fatihah, reciting aloud or quietly and reciting behind the imam; not reciting outside the prayer (see recitation-of-quran).

subtopics.title: Standing, Bowing and Rising
subtopics.description: Standing, bowing, what to say in ruku' and rising from it; not prostration (see prayer-prostration).

subtopics.title: Prostration and Sitting
subtopics.description: Prostrating, what to say in it, sitting between prostrations and getting up; not prostration of recitation (see recitation-prostration) nor of forgetfulness (see prayer-mistakes).

subtopics.title: Tashahhud and Ending the Prayer
subtopics.description: The tashahhud, the final sitting and the taslim that ends the prayer; not dhikr after the prayer (see prayer-remembrance).

subtopics.title: Forgetfulness and Errors in Prayer
subtopics.description: Prostration of forgetfulness, and actions or speech that spoil or are allowed in the prayer; not prayers missed altogether (see missed-prayers).

subtopics.title: Focus and Humility in Prayer
subtopics.description: Concentration, calm and humility in prayer and what distracts from it; not the prayer's motions.

topics.title: Mosques and Congregation
topics.description: Praying together, the imam, rows and the mosque; not how an individual prays (see prayer).

subtopics.title: Praying in Congregation
subtopics.description: The virtue and duty of praying in congregation and excuses for missing it; not who leads (see prayer-leader).

subtopics.title: The Imam and Following Him
subtopics.description: Who should lead, the imam's duties, keeping the prayer light for others, and following the imam without going ahead of him; not rows (see prayer-rows).

subtopics.title: Prayer Rows
subtopics.description: Straightening rows, where each person stands and praying alone behind the row; not following the imam (see prayer-leader).

subtopics.title: Mosques
subtopics.description: Building, entering, cleaning and sitting in mosques, the virtue of the three sacred mosques, and what may be done in a mosque; not other places of prayer (see prayer-places).

subtopics.title: Women at the Mosque
subtopics.description: Women attending mosques and communal prayers, where they stand and leaving before the men; not menstruation (see menstruation).

topics.title: Voluntary, Friday and Special Prayers
topics.description: Optional prayers and prayers for particular days and circumstances; not the five daily prayers (see prayer).

subtopics.title: Voluntary Prayers
subtopics.description: Sunnah prayers before and after the obligatory ones, duha, istikharah and other optional prayers by day; not night prayer (see night-prayer).

subtopics.title: Night Prayer and Tarawih
subtopics.description: Qiyam al-layl, tahajjud and the Ramadan night prayer; not witr itself (see witr-prayer).

subtopics.title: Witr
subtopics.description: The witr prayer, its time, number of units, recitation and qunut; not the rest of the night prayer (see night-prayer).

subtopics.title: Friday (Jumu'ah)
subtopics.description: The Friday prayer, its ghusl, khutbah, the hour of response and Friday's virtue; not the Eid prayers (see eid-prayers).

subtopics.title: The Two Eids
subtopics.description: The Eid prayers, their sermon and the conduct of Eid days; not the Eid sacrifice (see udhiyah).

subtopics.title: Eclipse Prayer
subtopics.description: Prayer and remembrance during a solar or lunar eclipse; not prayer for rain (see rain-prayer).

subtopics.title: Prayer for Rain (Istisqa)
subtopics.description: The prayer and supplication for rain and asking for rain to stop; not du'a when wind or thunder comes (see rain-and-weather).

subtopics.title: Prayer in Fear or Battle
subtopics.description: How to pray in fear, danger or battle; not prayer while travelling (see travel-prayer).

subtopics.title: Prayer While Travelling
subtopics.description: Shortening and combining prayers and praying on a mount while travelling; not travel manners (see travel).

subtopics.title: Praying Sitting or When Ill
subtopics.description: Praying sitting or lying down because of illness or inability, and voluntary prayer while sitting; not illness itself (see illness-reward).

subtopics.title: Prayer for Guidance (Istikhara)
subtopics.description: The prayer and supplication for seeking Allah's choice in a decision.

subtopics.title: Forenoon Prayer (Duha)
subtopics.description: The Duha prayer, its time and reward.

subtopics.title: Ramadan Night Prayer (Tarawih)
subtopics.description: Standing in prayer during Ramadan nights, in congregation or alone; not night prayer in general (see night-prayer).

topics.title: Fasting
topics.description: Ramadan, voluntary fasts, the rulings of fasting and i'tikaf; not zakat al-fitr (see zakat-al-fitr) nor the Eid prayer (see eid-prayers).

subtopics.title: Ramadan and the Moon
subtopics.description: Sighting the crescent, and the obligation and virtue of Ramadan; not suhur and iftar (see fasting-day).

subtopics.title: Suhur and Iftar
subtopics.description: The pre-dawn meal, breaking the fast, and when the fasting day starts and ends; not what breaks a fast (see fasting-breakers).

subtopics.title: What Breaks or Harms the Fast
subtopics.description: Eating by mistake, kissing, cupping, vomiting, intercourse while fasting, and guarding one's speech while fasting; not who is excused (see fasting-concessions).

subtopics.title: Excuses, Making Up and Expiation
subtopics.description: Fasting when travelling, ill, pregnant or menstruating, making up missed days and the expiation for breaking a fast; not voluntary fasts (see voluntary-fasting).

subtopics.title: Voluntary Fasting
subtopics.description: Fasting Arafah, Ashura, Mondays, the white days, the fast of Dawud, and days when fasting is not allowed; not Ramadan (see ramadan).

subtopics.title: I'tikaf and Laylat al-Qadr
subtopics.description: Seclusion in the mosque and seeking the Night of Decree; not general night prayer (see night-prayer).

subtopics.title: Suhur and Iftar
subtopics.description: The pre-dawn meal, hastening to break the fast, and what to break it with.

topics.title: Zakat and Charity
topics.description: Obligatory zakat and voluntary giving; not gifts between people (see gifts) nor endowments (see wills-and-endowments).

subtopics.title: Zakat Rulings
subtopics.description: Who must pay zakat, the sin of withholding it, and how much is due on money, livestock and crops; not zakat al-fitr (see zakat-al-fitr).

subtopics.title: Zakat al-Fitr
subtopics.description: The end-of-Ramadan payment, who pays it and its measure; not annual zakat (see zakat).

subtopics.title: Who May Receive Zakat and Charity
subtopics.description: Who may and may not receive zakat or sadaqah, including the Prophet's family; not begging (see asking-people).

subtopics.title: Voluntary Charity (Sadaqah)
subtopics.description: The virtue of giving, secret charity, generosity and charity on behalf of the dead; not gifts between people (see gifts).

subtopics.title: Asking People and Self-Sufficiency
subtopics.description: When asking people for money is allowed or blamed, taking what is given unasked, and being content; not who may receive zakat (see recipients-of-charity).

subtopics.title: Ongoing Charity (Sadaqah Jariyah)
subtopics.description: Deeds whose reward continues after death: wells, knowledge, a righteous child, endowed benefit.

subtopics.title: Charity and Deeds for the Dead
subtopics.description: Giving charity, fasting or Hajj on behalf of someone who has died.

subtopics.title: Everyday Good Deeds as Charity
subtopics.description: Smiling, a good word, removing harm, helping someone: small acts counted as charity.

topics.title: Hajj and Umrah
topics.description: The pilgrimage and its rites, plus the sanctity of Makkah and Madinah; not the Eid sacrifice at home (see udhiyah).

subtopics.title: Virtue and Obligation of Hajj
subtopics.description: Why hajj matters, who must go, and hajj on behalf of someone else; not the rites themselves (see ihram-and-miqat).

subtopics.title: Ihram, Miqat, Talbiyah and Kinds of Hajj
subtopics.description: Entering ihram, the stations, the talbiyah, and tamattu', qiran and ifrad; not what is forbidden in ihram (see muhrim-restrictions).

subtopics.title: What Is Forbidden in Ihram
subtopics.description: Perfume, hunting, sewn clothes, intercourse and other limits on the pilgrim, and their expiation; not the pilgrim's sacrifice (see hadi-sacrifice).

subtopics.title: Tawaf and Sa'i
subtopics.description: Circling the Ka'bah, the Black Stone and the corners, and walking between Safa and Marwah; not the sanctity of Makkah (see makkah-and-madinah).

subtopics.title: Arafah and Muzdalifah
subtopics.description: Standing at Arafah, the night at Muzdalifah, and the weak leaving early; not fasting on the day of Arafah (see voluntary-fasting).

subtopics.title: Mina and Stoning the Jamarat
subtopics.description: Staying at Mina, stoning the pillars and the order of the rites on the day of sacrifice; not Arafah (see arafah-muzdalifah).

subtopics.title: Pilgrim's Sacrifice, Shaving and Leaving Ihram
subtopics.description: The animals pilgrims drive and sacrifice, shaving or shortening the hair and leaving ihram; not the Eid sacrifice at home (see udhiyah).

subtopics.title: Umrah
subtopics.description: The lesser pilgrimage, its virtue and its timing; not hajj-only rites (see arafah-muzdalifah).

subtopics.title: Makkah and Madinah
subtopics.description: The sanctity and virtues of Makkah, Madinah and their sanctuaries, and entering the Ka'bah; not tawaf (see tawaf-and-sai) nor mosques elsewhere (see mosques).

topics.title: Remembrance and Supplication
topics.description: Remembering Allah and asking Him, in daily life and around the prayer; not Qur'an recitation (see recitation-of-quran).

subtopics.title: Supplication (Du'a)
subtopics.description: How to make du'a, when it is answered, and praying for or against others; not set words for daily moments (see daily-adhkar).

subtopics.title: Remembrance of Allah (Dhikr)
subtopics.description: Tasbih, tahlil, takbir, praise of Allah and gatherings of dhikr; not supplications that ask for something (see supplication).

subtopics.title: Words for Morning, Evening, Bedtime and Daily Moments
subtopics.description: Set words for morning, evening, going to bed, waking, entering the home or market and similar moments; not dhikr after the prayer (see prayer-remembrance).

subtopics.title: Dhikr and Du'a In and After Prayer
subtopics.description: Supplications inside the prayer, dhikr after the salam, and what to say after the adhan; not the tashahhud itself (see prayer-ending).

subtopics.title: Seeking Refuge in Allah
subtopics.description: Asking Allah for protection from evils, debt, laziness, the grave and trials; not ruqyah over the sick (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

subtopics.title: Sending Blessings on the Prophet
subtopics.description: Salawat on the Prophet and its virtue; not the tashahhud as a whole (see prayer-ending).

subtopics.title: Manners and Acceptance of Dua
subtopics.description: How to supplicate, times and states when dua is answered, and what blocks acceptance.

subtopics.title: Praying for Others
subtopics.description: Supplicating for others in their absence, for parents, for the believers, and asking others to pray.

topics.title: The Heart and Spiritual Life
topics.description: Inner states, intentions, repentance and the balance of this world and the next; not outward manners (see character).

subtopics.title: Intention and Sincerity
subtopics.description: Deeds by intentions, acting for Allah alone, and showing off; not steadiness in doing good (see deeds-and-reward).

subtopics.title: Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
subtopics.description: Turning back to Allah after sin, His acceptance of it, and the words and virtue of istighfar; not the gravity of sins themselves (see sins-and-major-sins).

subtopics.title: This World and Detachment (Zuhd)
subtopics.description: The worth of this world, simple living, and poverty and wealth seen spiritually; not trade rules (see buying-and-selling).

subtopics.title: Trust, Fear and Hope in Allah
subtopics.description: Tawakkul, fear of Allah, piety and avoiding doubtful things, and hope in His mercy; not the decree as a doctrine (see divine-decree).

subtopics.title: Good Deeds and Their Reward
subtopics.description: Doing good, steadiness and moderation in worship, and how deeds are rewarded or erased; not sincerity of intention (see intention-and-sincerity).

subtopics.title: Sins and Major Sins
subtopics.description: Major sins, the danger of sinning and sins erased by good deeds; not legal punishments (see hudud).

subtopics.title: Gratitude and Contentment
subtopics.description: Thanking Allah, being content with one's provision and looking at those below you; not thanking people (see good-character).

subtopics.title: Patience
subtopics.description: Patience in hardship, in obedience and in avoiding sin, and its reward; not grief at a death (see mourning-and-wailing).

subtopics.title: Love of Allah and His Messenger
subtopics.description: Loving Allah and the Prophet more than all else, and the signs and fruits of that love.

subtopics.title: Showing Off (Riya)
subtopics.description: Doing deeds to be seen or praised, and seeking fame; not sincerity in general (see intention-and-sincerity).

subtopics.title: Arrogance and Pride
subtopics.description: Pride, looking down on people and rejecting truth; not humility as a virtue (see humility-modesty).

subtopics.title: Greed and Stinginess
subtopics.description: Miserliness, greed for wealth and never being satisfied; not generosity (see generosity).

subtopics.title: Self-Accountability
subtopics.description: Taking oneself to account, remembering death and preparing for it before it comes.

topics.title: Character
topics.description: Personal virtues and vices, especially in speech; not the etiquette of greetings and gatherings (see etiquette).

subtopics.title: Truthfulness and Lying
subtopics.description: Telling the truth, the sin of lying and when indirect speech is allowed; not false witness in court (see judges-and-testimony).

subtopics.title: Trusts, Promises and Keeping Secrets
subtopics.description: Keeping trusts, promises and secrets and the sin of betrayal; not oaths (see oaths-and-vows).

subtopics.title: Guarding the Tongue, Cursing and Foul Speech
subtopics.description: Speaking good or staying silent, idle talk, cursing, insults and foul speech; not backbiting (see backbiting-slander).

subtopics.title: Backbiting, Gossip and Slander
subtopics.description: Speaking ill of someone absent, carrying tales and spreading accusations; not cursing or insults (see guarding-the-tongue).

subtopics.title: Kindness, Mercy and Gentleness
subtopics.description: Mercy, gentleness, forbearance and pardoning people; not kindness to animals (see kindness-to-animals).

subtopics.title: Humility, Modesty and Arrogance
subtopics.description: Humility, modesty and shyness (haya), and the sins of pride and boasting; not trailing clothes as a dress rule (see clothing).

subtopics.title: Anger, Envy, Hatred and Suspicion
subtopics.description: Controlling anger, envy, grudges, spying, suspicion and boycotting each other; not the evil eye (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

subtopics.title: Good Character in General
subtopics.description: The virtue of good manners in general and who the best people are; not a specific virtue that has its own node, such as gentleness (see kindness-and-gentleness).

subtopics.title: Generosity
subtopics.description: Giving freely, open-handedness and preferring others; not formal charity rules (see voluntary-charity).

subtopics.title: Forgiving and Pardoning
subtopics.description: Pardoning those who wrong you, overlooking faults and not taking revenge.

subtopics.title: Courage
subtopics.description: Bravery, standing firm and the Prophet's courage; not fighting rules (see conduct-of-war).

subtopics.title: Keeping Secrets and Confidences
subtopics.description: Keeping what is entrusted, private talk and not exposing others' faults.

subtopics.title: Mocking and Insulting
subtopics.description: Ridicule, name-calling, insulting people and looking down on them.

subtopics.title: Cursing and Foul Language
subtopics.description: Cursing people, animals or time, obscenity and harsh words.

subtopics.title: Suspicion and Spying
subtopics.description: Bad assumptions about people, spying and prying into their affairs.

subtopics.title: Mercy and Compassion
subtopics.description: Showing mercy to people and creation and Allah's mercy to the merciful; not gentleness in manner (see kindness-and-gentleness).

subtopics.title: Arguing and Disputes
subtopics.description: Quarrelling, stubborn argument, leaving argument even when right.

topics.title: Social Etiquette
topics.description: The manners of everyday meetings and speech with people; not inner character (see character).

subtopics.title: Greeting with Salam
subtopics.description: Saying and returning salam, who greets whom, shaking hands and embracing; not the taslim ending the prayer (see prayer-ending).

subtopics.title: Seeking Permission and Privacy
subtopics.description: Asking permission before entering, looking into houses and respecting privacy; not household safety (see home-and-household).

subtopics.title: Sneezing and Yawning
subtopics.description: What to say when sneezing and how to yawn; not yawning inside the prayer (see prayer-mistakes).

subtopics.title: Sitting and Gatherings
subtopics.description: Manners of sitting, gatherings, whispering and sitting in the street; not mosque manners (see mosques).

subtopics.title: Names and Nicknames
subtopics.description: Good and disliked names, kunyas and changing names; not newborn rites (see children).

subtopics.title: Joking, Laughter, Poetry and Speech Style
subtopics.description: Joking, laughter, poetry, praising people, eloquence and letter writing; not lying (see truthfulness-and-lying).

subtopics.title: Manners of the Road and Public Places
subtopics.description: Sitting on the road, lowering the gaze, removing harm from the path, public conduct.

subtopics.title: Entering and Leaving Home
subtopics.description: What to say and do when entering or leaving a house.

subtopics.title: Visiting and Meeting People
subtopics.description: Visiting friends and brothers, meeting people warmly, handshake and embrace.

subtopics.title: Manners of Speech
subtopics.description: Speaking clearly, kindly and briefly, speaking good or keeping silent; not lying or backbiting (see their own subtopics).

topics.title: Neighbours and Community
topics.description: How Muslims treat one another and society; not close family (see family).

subtopics.title: Neighbours
subtopics.description: The rights of neighbours, the sin of harming them and what to do about a neighbour who harms you; not guests (see guests-and-hospitality).

subtopics.title: Guests and Hospitality
subtopics.description: Honouring guests, accepting invitations and the host's duties; not wedding feasts (see wedding).

subtopics.title: Brotherhood and Love for Allah's Sake
subtopics.description: Love between believers, friendship, visiting and keeping good company; not kinship ties (see kinship-ties).

subtopics.title: Helping Others and Public Good
subtopics.description: Meeting people's needs, removing harm from the road, interceding for people and defending a Muslim's honour; not making peace or forbidding evil (see reconciliation).

subtopics.title: Making Peace and Forbidding Evil
subtopics.description: Reconciling people, enjoining good and forbidding evil, and sincere advice; not treaties in war (see peace-treaties).

subtopics.title: Gifts
subtopics.description: Giving, accepting and taking back gifts, including lifetime gifts; not charity (see voluntary-charity) nor endowments (see wills-and-endowments).

subtopics.title: Relations with Non-Muslims
subtopics.description: Dealing with Jews, Christians and other non-Muslims in daily life; not war or jizyah (see conduct-of-war, public-funds).

subtopics.title: Rights of Muslims on Each Other
subtopics.description: Returning greetings, visiting the sick, following funerals, answering invitations and other mutual duties.

subtopics.title: Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil
subtopics.description: Changing wrong with hand, tongue or heart, giving sincere advice, and the duty to speak up.

subtopics.title: Respecting Elders, Mercy to the Young
subtopics.description: Honouring the old, being merciful to children and the young in society.

subtopics.title: Friends and Company
subtopics.description: Choosing good companions, the effect of company, and bad friends.

subtopics.title: Cutting Off and Shunning
subtopics.description: Not shunning a brother more than three days, cutting off relations and its limits.

subtopics.title: People with Disabilities
subtopics.description: The blind, the disabled and the weak in body: their rights, reward and concessions.

topics.title: Family
topics.description: Parents, children, kin and the household's needs; not marriage itself (see marriage).

subtopics.title: Parents
subtopics.description: Honouring, obeying and caring for parents, including after their death; not inheritance (see inheritance).

subtopics.title: Ties of Kinship
subtopics.description: Keeping and cutting family ties and helping relatives; not parents specifically (see parents).

subtopics.title: Children and Newborns
subtopics.description: Newborns, 'aqiqah and tahnik, kindness and fairness to children, raising daughters and children joining worship; not orphans (see orphans).

subtopics.title: Orphans and Guardianship
subtopics.description: Caring for orphans and widows, guardians managing an orphan's wealth, and custody of children; not general charity (see voluntary-charity).

subtopics.title: Lineage and Paternity
subtopics.description: Claiming lineage, paternity disputes and 'the child belongs to the bed'; not names (see names-and-kunyas).

subtopics.title: Breastfeeding and Foster Kinship
subtopics.description: Breastfeeding and the kinship it creates; not childcare in general (see children).

subtopics.title: Spending on Family
subtopics.description: Providing for wife, children and relatives, as a duty and as charity; not zakat (see zakat).

subtopics.title: Women's Status and Rights
subtopics.description: The rights, honour and duties of women generally; not menstruation (see menstruation) nor dress (see women-dress-hijab).

subtopics.title: Aqiqah and the Newborn
subtopics.description: Sacrifice for a newborn, shaving the head, tahnik and naming at birth.

subtopics.title: Fairness Between Children
subtopics.description: Equal treatment and gifts among children.

subtopics.title: Daughters and Sisters
subtopics.description: The reward for raising daughters and sisters well and honouring them.

subtopics.title: Widows and Single Parents
subtopics.description: Caring for widows, a mother raising children alone, and those who support them.

subtopics.title: Adoption, Fostering and Guardianship
subtopics.description: Adopted and fostered children, naming them after their fathers, guardianship.

topics.title: Marriage and Divorce
topics.description: Forming, living in and ending a marriage; not raising children (see children).

subtopics.title: Proposal, Guardian and Consent
subtopics.description: Encouragement to marry, choosing a spouse, looking at her, proposing, the guardian and consent; not the dowry (see marriage-contract-and-mahr).

subtopics.title: Marriage Contract and Dowry
subtopics.description: The contract, its conditions and the mahr; not marriages that are not allowed (see forbidden-marriages).

subtopics.title: Marriages That Are Not Allowed
subtopics.description: Who one may not marry, shighar, mut'ah, tahlil, combining sisters, more than four wives, and marriage across faiths; not foster kinship itself (see breastfeeding).

subtopics.title: The Wedding and Walimah
subtopics.description: Announcing the marriage, the feast, the duff and congratulating the couple; not hospitality in general (see guests-and-hospitality).

subtopics.title: Rights of Husband and Wife
subtopics.description: Mutual rights between spouses in general; for how each should be see husband-role and wife-role.

subtopics.title: Intimacy
subtopics.description: The etiquette and rulings of intercourse, 'azl and what is forbidden; not ghusl after it (see ghusl).

subtopics.title: Divorce and Khul'
subtopics.description: Talaq, its kinds and timing, taking a wife back, and khul' (a wife seeking release); not li'an or zihar (see marital-oaths-accusations).

subtopics.title: Li'an, Zihar and Ila'
subtopics.description: Mutual cursing over an accusation, the zihar declaration and oaths to stay away from a wife; not slander punishments (see sexual-offences).

subtopics.title: Waiting Period and Mourning
subtopics.description: The 'iddah after divorce or death and how a widow mourns; not funeral wailing (see mourning-and-wailing).

subtopics.title: Choosing a Spouse
subtopics.description: What to look for in a spouse: religion, character, compatibility; not the proposal procedure (see proposal-and-consent).

subtopics.title: The Husband's Role
subtopics.description: How a husband should treat his wife and family: kindness, provision, patience, the best of you to their wives.

subtopics.title: The Wife's Role
subtopics.description: How a wife should be with her husband: the righteous wife, cooperation, guarding his home and honour.

subtopics.title: Disputes Between Spouses
subtopics.description: Quarrels, dislike and reconciliation between husband and wife; not divorce rulings (see divorce).

subtopics.title: Polygyny and Fairness Between Wives
subtopics.description: Having more than one wife and dividing time and spending justly.

subtopics.title: Khul' (Divorce at the Wife's Request)
subtopics.description: A wife ending the marriage by returning the mahr, and its conditions.

topics.title: Food, Drink and Slaughter
topics.description: What and how we eat and drink, and how animals are slaughtered for food; not fasting (see fasting).

subtopics.title: Eating Etiquette
subtopics.description: Bismillah, the right hand, washing hands, sharing, not criticising food and how the Prophet ate; not which foods are lawful (see lawful-and-forbidden-food).

subtopics.title: Drinking Etiquette and Vessels
subtopics.description: Drinking while seated, breathing outside the vessel, passing drink to the right and which vessels to use; not intoxicants (see intoxicants).

subtopics.title: Lawful and Forbidden Food
subtopics.description: Which meat and foods are allowed (donkeys, lizards, locusts, sea food, dead animals) and eating out of necessity; not the slaughter method (see slaughter).

subtopics.title: Intoxicants
subtopics.description: Wine, nabidh, the vessels used for it and the ban on intoxicants; not the punishment for drinking (see hudud).

subtopics.title: Particular Foods
subtopics.description: Dates, milk, honey, meat, bread and other named foods and drinks; not medicine with them (see medicine-and-remedies).

subtopics.title: Slaughtering Animals
subtopics.description: How to slaughter, the tools, and saying Allah's name; not the Eid sacrifice (see udhiyah).

subtopics.title: Hunting
subtopics.description: Hunting with dogs, falcons and arrows and eating game; not hunting in ihram (see muhrim-restrictions).

subtopics.title: Eid Sacrifice (Udhiyah)
subtopics.description: The Eid al-Adha sacrifice, which animals qualify, its timing and storing its meat; not the pilgrim's sacrifice (see hadi-sacrifice).

subtopics.title: Moderation and Not Wasting Food
subtopics.description: Not overeating, sharing food, not wasting it, the stomach thirds.

topics.title: Dress and Adornment
topics.description: Clothing, jewellery, grooming and images; not what to wear in prayer (see prayer-clothing).

subtopics.title: Clothing
subtopics.description: Garments, colours, trailing the lower garment and how to dress; not silk and gold (see silk-and-gold).

subtopics.title: Shoes and Sandals
subtopics.description: Putting on, walking in and taking off shoes and sandals; not wiping over socks (see wiping-footwear).

subtopics.title: Silk, Gold and Silver
subtopics.description: Silk and gold for men and women and gold or silver vessels; not rings (see rings-and-jewellery).

subtopics.title: Rings and Jewellery
subtopics.description: Wearing and engraving rings, and women's jewellery; not gold as currency (see riba).

subtopics.title: Hair, Beard and Natural Grooming (Fitrah)
subtopics.description: Hair, beard, moustache, dyeing, wigs, nails, circumcision, tattoos and other body care; not siwak (see siwak).

subtopics.title: Perfume and Kohl
subtopics.description: Using perfume, musk and kohl; not perfume in ihram (see muhrim-restrictions).

subtopics.title: Pictures and Images
subtopics.description: Images, statues, picture-makers and decorated cloths in the home; not dreams (see dreams-and-visions).

subtopics.title: Women's Covering and Hijab
subtopics.description: Women's covering, hijab and the verse of hijab; not men's clothing (see clothing).

subtopics.title: Tattoos and Body Alterations
subtopics.description: Tattooing, plucking, hair extensions and changing Allah's creation.

topics.title: Health, Illness and Ruqyah
topics.description: Illness, visiting the sick, medicine and spiritual healing; not death and funerals (see funerals).

subtopics.title: Illness and Its Reward
subtopics.description: Sickness as expiation, patience in illness and what the sick person may say; not visiting the sick (see visiting-sick).

subtopics.title: Visiting the Sick
subtopics.description: Visiting the sick, what to say and supplicate for them; not someone who is dying (see dying-and-death).

subtopics.title: Medicine and Remedies
subtopics.description: Treatments such as honey, cupping, black seed and cauterisation, and seeking a cure; not ruqyah (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

subtopics.title: Ruqyah, Evil Eye and Magic
subtopics.description: Reciting over the sick, the evil eye, magic and amulets; not daily words of protection (see seeking-refuge).

subtopics.title: Contagion and Plague
subtopics.description: Plague, leprosy, whether disease spreads, and entering or leaving a plague land; not illness as expiation (see illness-reward).

subtopics.title: Hygiene and Cleanliness
subtopics.description: Cleanliness of body, home and surroundings as part of faith; not ritual purification (see wudu, ghusl).

topics.title: Animals
topics.description: How to treat animals and which may be kept or killed; not the rules of slaughter (see slaughter).

subtopics.title: Kindness to Animals
subtopics.description: Mercy to animals, feeding them, and not tormenting, branding or overloading them; not hunting (see hunting).

subtopics.title: Dogs and Cats
subtopics.description: Keeping dogs, their impurity, and cats' leftovers; not hunting dogs (see hunting).

subtopics.title: Snakes, Geckos and Harmful Creatures
subtopics.description: Which creatures may be killed and insects that fall into food; not hunting (see hunting).

subtopics.title: Horses, Camels and Livestock
subtopics.description: Horses, camels, sheep, riding and caring for livestock; not zakat on them (see zakat) nor racing (see sports-and-recreation).

topics.title: Daily Life
topics.description: Everyday routines outside worship; not formal worship.

subtopics.title: Sleep
subtopics.description: Going to bed, sleeping positions and waking up; not dreams (see dreams-and-visions) nor bedtime words (see daily-adhkar).

subtopics.title: Travel
subtopics.description: Travelling alone or in groups, a woman travelling, farewells, returning home and travel du'a; not prayer while travelling (see travel-prayer).

subtopics.title: Home and Household
subtopics.description: Houses, lamps, doors, covering vessels at night, household safety and chores; not seeking permission to enter (see seeking-permission).

subtopics.title: Earning a Living and Work
subtopics.description: Working with one's hands, crafts and earning lawfully; not hiring contracts (see hiring-and-partnership).

subtopics.title: Sports, Games and Entertainment
subtopics.description: Archery, racing, wrestling, games, music and singing; not training for war (see preparation-and-weapons).

subtopics.title: Using Time and Health Well
subtopics.description: Taking advantage of time, health, youth and free time before they pass.

topics.title: Money, Trade and Property
topics.description: Buying, selling, debts, property and passing wealth on; not charity (see charity).

subtopics.title: Buying and Selling
subtopics.description: Sales, conditions, delivery, advance payment (salam), options to cancel, defects and honest, lenient trading; not forbidden sales (see forbidden-sales).

subtopics.title: Forbidden Sales, Cheating and Unlawful Earnings
subtopics.description: Gharar, muzabanah, najsh, hoarding, selling before possession, cheating, and earning from forbidden things (selling dogs or wine, fortune-telling); not usury (see riba).

subtopics.title: Interest (Riba) and Currency Exchange
subtopics.description: Usury and exchanging gold, silver and food items like for like; not loans without interest (see debts-and-loans).

subtopics.title: Debts, Loans, Pledges and Bankruptcy
subtopics.description: Borrowing, repaying, delaying debts, pledges, guarantees, bankruptcy and restricting a spendthrift; not inheritance (see inheritance).

subtopics.title: Land, Water and Sharecropping
subtopics.description: Leasing land, sharecropping, irrigation, reviving dead land, boundaries and pre-emption (shuf'ah); not zakat on crops (see zakat).

subtopics.title: Hiring, Wages and Partnership
subtopics.description: Employing workers, wages, renting, agency and partnership; not slavery (see treatment-of-slaves).

subtopics.title: Lost Property and Taking Others' Property
subtopics.description: Lost and found items, borrowed items, usurping and damaging property; not theft punishment (see theft-penalties).

subtopics.title: Inheritance
subtopics.description: Shares of heirs, grandparents, kalalah and who cannot inherit; not wills (see wills-and-endowments).

subtopics.title: Wills and Endowments
subtopics.description: Making a will, the one-third limit, waqf and charity for the dead; not inheritance shares (see inheritance).

subtopics.title: Wealth and Poverty
subtopics.description: The trial of wealth and of poverty, the grateful rich and the patient poor.

subtopics.title: Cheating and Fraud
subtopics.description: Cheating in trade, hiding defects, false measures and deceiving people.

subtopics.title: Bribery and Corruption
subtopics.description: Giving and taking bribes, gifts to officials and misuse of position for gain.

subtopics.title: Gambling and Games of Chance
subtopics.description: Gambling, betting and their prohibition.

subtopics.title: Workers and Wages
subtopics.description: Paying workers on time, their rights, and treating employees and servants well; not hiring contracts (see hiring-and-partnership).

topics.title: Justice and Law
topics.description: Courts, crimes, punishments, oaths and vows; not rulers and politics (see governance).

subtopics.title: Judges, Witnesses and Claims
subtopics.description: Judging, evidence, witnesses, the defendant's oath and settling disputes; not oaths in general (see oaths-and-vows).

subtopics.title: Prescribed Punishments: General Rules
subtopics.description: How prescribed punishments are applied, intercession, pardon and covering faults, and the punishments for drinking and banditry; not theft (see theft-penalties) nor zina and slander (see sexual-offences).

subtopics.title: Theft and Its Punishment
subtopics.description: Theft, robbery, the minimum value and cutting the hand; not lost property (see lost-property-and-usurpation).

subtopics.title: Zina and Slander
subtopics.description: Unlawful sex, stoning and flogging, and false accusation of zina (qadhf); not li'an between spouses (see marital-oaths-accusations).

subtopics.title: Retaliation and Blood Money
subtopics.description: Qisas, diyah for killing and injury, and accidental killing; not the sin of murder itself (see sanctity-life).

subtopics.title: Killing, Suicide and Self-Defence
subtopics.description: The sanctity of life, the sin of murder and suicide, and defending oneself or one's property; not retaliation and blood money (see retaliation-and-blood-money).

subtopics.title: Oaths and Vows
subtopics.description: Swearing, what one may swear by, breaking oaths, their expiation, and keeping or abandoning vows; not testimony in court (see judges-and-testimony).

subtopics.title: Oppression and Others' Rights
subtopics.description: Wrongdoing and usurping others' rights as a legal and moral matter; equality and discrimination are under justice-and-equality.

subtopics.title: Suicide and Self-Harm
subtopics.description: Taking one's own life, wishing for death and harming oneself.

topics.title: Slaves and Servants
topics.description: Treating slaves and servants and freeing them; not hired workers (see hiring-and-partnership).

subtopics.title: Treatment of Slaves and Servants
subtopics.description: Kindness to slaves and servants, beating them and their duties; not freeing them (see freeing-slaves).

subtopics.title: Freeing Slaves
subtopics.description: The virtue of manumission, mukatab contracts, umm walad and wala'; not treatment (see treatment-of-slaves).

topics.title: Rulers and Public Affairs
topics.description: Leadership, rulers and the community's affairs; not courts (see law).

subtopics.title: Rulers and Obedience
subtopics.description: Obeying those in authority, refusing sinful orders, advising rulers and patience with unjust ones; not the pledge of allegiance (see allegiance-and-unity).

subtopics.title: Leadership and Responsibility
subtopics.description: Seeking office, the shepherd's duty, appointing officials and misusing office; not family duties (see spousal-rights).

subtopics.title: Allegiance, Unity and Rebels
subtopics.description: The pledge of allegiance, staying with the community, and those who split from it, including rebels and khawarij; not ordinary war (see conduct-of-war).

subtopics.title: Public Funds, Khumus and Jizyah
subtopics.description: Khumus, fay', jizyah, kharaj and salaries from public money; not personal zakat (see zakat).

subtopics.title: Consultation (Shura)
subtopics.description: Consulting people in decisions and the duty of the consulted to advise honestly.

subtopics.title: Seeking Position and Office
subtopics.description: Asking for leadership or office, its burden, and appointing the qualified.

topics.title: Jihad and Warfare
topics.description: Struggle in Allah's cause and the conduct of war; not the Prophet's battles as history (see historical-campaigns).

subtopics.title: Virtue of Jihad and Martyrdom
subtopics.description: The reward of jihad, guarding the frontier and martyrdom; not the rules of fighting (see conduct-of-war).

subtopics.title: Conduct in War
subtopics.description: Who may be fought or killed, captives, inviting to Islam before fighting, and deception in war; not treaties (see peace-treaties) nor spoils (see spoils-of-war).

subtopics.title: Treaties and Safe Conduct
subtopics.description: Covenants, truces, safe conduct and the sin of treachery; not the fighting itself (see conduct-of-war).

subtopics.title: Spoils of War
subtopics.description: Dividing booty, the fighters' shares and stealing from the spoils; not jizyah (see public-funds).

subtopics.title: Weapons, Horses and Preparation
subtopics.description: Weapons, archery for war, flags, horses and equipping fighters; not racing as sport (see sports-and-recreation).

subtopics.title: Kinds of Martyrdom
subtopics.description: Those counted as martyrs: dying of plague, drowning, defending property or family, and the like.

topics.title: The Prophet and Earlier Prophets
topics.description: Muhammad's life, character and family, and the stories of earlier prophets; not his companions' virtues (see companions).

subtopics.title: The Prophet's Character and Appearance
subtopics.description: How the Prophet looked, lived, ate, dressed and behaved; not events of his life (see seerah-events).

subtopics.title: Events of the Prophet's Life
subtopics.description: The start of revelation, persecution in Makkah, the hijrah, delegations, the farewell hajj and his death; not battles (see historical-campaigns).

subtopics.title: Battles and Expeditions
subtopics.description: Named battles, raids and conquests (Badr, Uhud, the Trench, Khaibar, Hunain, Tabuk) as events; not the rules of war (see conduct-of-war).

subtopics.title: Signs and Miracles of Prophethood
subtopics.description: Miracles, the Night Journey and the proofs of prophethood; not earlier prophets (see earlier-prophets).

subtopics.title: The Prophet's Family and Wives
subtopics.description: The Prophet's wives, children and household; not companions in general (see virtues-of-companions).

subtopics.title: Earlier Prophets and Nations
subtopics.description: Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, 'Isa and other prophets, and past nations; not end-time events (see dajjal-and-major-signs).

subtopics.title: The Prophet's Character and Manners
subtopics.description: How the Prophet dealt with people: his kindness, forgiveness, humour and humility; not his appearance (see prophet-description).

subtopics.title: The Prophet at Home
subtopics.description: The Prophet's household life, simplicity, helping at home and with his family.

subtopics.title: The Prophet's Worship
subtopics.description: How the Prophet worshipped: his night prayer, fasting, dhikr and devotion.

topics.title: Companions and Virtuous People
topics.description: The virtues of the Companions, tribes and righteous people; not the Prophet himself (see prophet).

subtopics.title: Virtues of Individual Companions
subtopics.description: Abu Bakr, 'Umar, 'Uthman, 'Ali and other named companions; not tribes (see tribes-and-peoples).

subtopics.title: Tribes, Places and Peoples
subtopics.description: Virtues of the Ansar, Muhajirun, Quraish, Yemen and other tribes and lands; not individual companions (see virtues-of-companions).

subtopics.title: Women of the Early Community
subtopics.description: Virtues of Khadijah, Fatimah, 'A'ishah, Umm Sulaim and other women; not marriage rules (see spousal-rights).

subtopics.title: The Best Generations and This Ummah
subtopics.description: The excellence of the Companions' generation and of this nation; not end-time signs (see signs-of-the-hour).

topics.title: Death and Funerals
topics.description: Dying, preparing the body, the funeral and the grave; not what happens after death (see hereafter).

subtopics.title: Dying and Remembering Death
subtopics.description: The dying person, talqin, wishing for death and sudden death; not grief (see mourning-and-wailing).

subtopics.title: Washing and Shrouding the Dead
subtopics.description: Washing the body, the shroud and perfume for the dead; not ghusl of the living (see ghusl).

subtopics.title: Funeral Prayer and Procession
subtopics.description: The janazah prayer, its takbirs, and carrying, following and standing for the bier; not burial (see burial-and-graves).

subtopics.title: Burial and Graves
subtopics.description: Burying, the shape of graves, visiting and building on graves; not punishment in the grave (see grave-and-barzakh).

subtopics.title: Mourning, Wailing and Condolence
subtopics.description: Weeping over the dead, forbidden wailing, losing children, condolence and food for the bereaved; not the widow's 'iddah (see iddah-and-mourning).

subtopics.title: Condolence and Consoling the Bereaved
subtopics.description: Consoling a bereaved family, what to say, preparing food for them.

subtopics.title: Praying for the Dead
subtopics.description: Supplicating and seeking forgiveness for the dead and visiting graves to pray for them; not the funeral prayer (see funeral-prayer).

topics.title: The Hereafter and the Last Hour
topics.description: The signs and trials before the Hour, then the grave, resurrection, judgement, Paradise and Hell; not funerals (see funerals).

subtopics.title: The Grave and Its Trial
subtopics.description: Questioning in the grave, its punishment and its bliss; not burial rules (see burial-and-graves).

subtopics.title: Resurrection and the Day of Judgement
subtopics.description: The trumpet, resurrection, gathering, reckoning, the scales and the bridge; not Paradise itself (see paradise).

subtopics.title: Intercession
subtopics.description: The Prophet's and others' intercession on the Day and people taken out of the Fire; not interceding between people in this world (see helping-and-public-good).

subtopics.title: Paradise
subtopics.description: Paradise, its people, its delights and seeing Allah; not the deeds that lead there (see deeds-and-reward).

subtopics.title: Hellfire
subtopics.description: Hell, its punishment and its people; not the grave (see grave-and-barzakh).

subtopics.title: Signs of the Hour
subtopics.description: Minor signs before the Hour and when it will come; not the Dajjal and the major signs (see dajjal-and-major-signs).

subtopics.title: Tribulations (Fitan)
subtopics.description: Times of trial and civil strife and how to behave in them; not personal hardship (see patience).

subtopics.title: Dajjal, 'Isa, Mahdi and Major Signs
subtopics.description: The False Messiah, the descent of 'Isa, the Mahdi, Gog and Magog and the Beast; not minor signs (see signs-of-the-hour).

topics.title: Justice, Equality and Dignity
topics.description: Equality of people, fighting discrimination and injustice, and the dignity of every human; legal rights and wrongdoing in courts stay under law.

subtopics.title: Equality of All People
subtopics.description: No superiority of Arab over non-Arab, white over black, except by piety; all from Adam.

subtopics.title: Racism and Tribal Pride
subtopics.description: Pride in lineage, colour or tribe, calling people by their origin to insult them.

subtopics.title: Discrimination and Unfair Treatment
subtopics.description: Treating people as lesser for their origin, colour, poverty, gender or status; favouring the rich over the poor.

subtopics.title: Standing for Justice
subtopics.description: Being just even against oneself, kin or friends, and fair dealing with enemies.

subtopics.title: Helping the Oppressed
subtopics.description: Supporting the wronged, stopping the oppressor, and the supplication of the oppressed.

subtopics.title: Rights of the Weak and Vulnerable
subtopics.description: Protecting the poor, women, orphans, servants and the powerless; being helped through the weak.

subtopics.title: Human Dignity
subtopics.description: Honour of every person, not humiliating people, sanctity of honour, wealth and blood as dignity.

topics.title: Nature and the Environment
topics.description: Planting, water, natural resources and signs in creation.

subtopics.title: Planting and Trees
subtopics.description: The reward for planting, trees and caring for the land; not land contracts (see land-water-farming).

subtopics.title: Water and Natural Resources
subtopics.description: Not wasting water, sharing water, grazing and fire as common goods.

subtopics.title: Wind, Rain, Thunder and Signs
subtopics.description: Wind, rain, thunder, earthquakes and eclipses as signs, and what to say; not the rain prayer (see rain-prayer).

subtopics.title: Creation and the Universe
subtopics.description: The creation of the heavens, earth, sun, moon and creatures.

topics.title: Blessed Times and Places
topics.description: Virtues of particular days, months, nights and lands as such.

subtopics.title: Virtues of Days, Nights and Months
subtopics.description: The virtue of particular days, nights and months (Friday, sacred months, Sha'ban, Dhul-Hijjah) as times; not the acts done in them (see their own subtopics).

subtopics.title: Virtues of Lands and Cities
subtopics.description: Jerusalem and al-Aqsa, Sham, Yemen and other lands; not Makkah and Madinah (see makkah-and-madinah).

situations.title: When You Are Angry
situations.description: What to say and do when anger rises; not anger as a trait of character (see anger-envy).

situations.title: Worry, Distress and Calamity
situations.description: Words and patience for worry, sorrow, distress and calamity; not the death of a loved one (see grief-and-loss).

situations.title: Losing a Loved One
situations.description: Losing a child, parent or spouse, weeping and patience at the first shock; not funeral procedures (see funeral-prayer).

situations.title: When You Are Ill
situations.description: Being sick, the reward for illness and what the sick should say or do; not medical rulings (see medicine-and-remedies).

situations.title: When Death Is Near
situations.description: Preparing for death, the dying person's words, and caring for someone near death; not burial (see burial-and-graves).

situations.title: In Debt
situations.description: Owing money, du'a about debt and asking for time to repay; not trade rules (see debts-and-loans).

situations.title: Poverty and Hard Times
situations.description: Little money or food, asking for help and seeking provision; not giving charity (see voluntary-charity).

situations.title: Looking for Work and Earning
situations.description: Seeking lawful provision and working rather than asking; not trade rules (see buying-and-selling).

situations.title: Fear and Feeling Unsafe
situations.description: What to say and do when afraid of people, enemies or the night; not fear of Allah (see trust-fear-hope).

situations.title: Public Turmoil and Keeping Away
situations.description: How to act in civil strife, when to keep away from people, and the value of seclusion or company; not war (see conduct-of-war).

situations.title: Setting Out on a Journey
situations.description: Du'a and manners when leaving, on the road and returning; not prayer rulings (see travel-prayer).

situations.title: Getting Married
situations.description: Thinking about marriage, choosing a spouse, proposing and the wedding; not divorce (see divorce).

situations.title: Trouble in a Marriage
situations.description: Disputes between spouses, jealousy, disobedience and thinking of divorce; not divorce rules themselves (see divorce).

situations.title: Having a Baby
situations.description: A newborn's tahnik, naming and 'aqiqah; not breastfeeding law (see breastfeeding).

situations.title: Raising Children
situations.description: Teaching, disciplining, kissing and being fair to children, and caring for daughters; not orphans (see caring-for-orphans-and-needy).

situations.title: Caring for Parents
situations.description: Honouring, serving and praying for parents, including elderly or non-Muslim parents; not inheritance (see inheritance).

situations.title: Caring for Orphans and the Needy
situations.description: Supporting orphans, widows, relatives and the poor; not zakat rulings (see zakat).

situations.title: After Committing a Sin
situations.description: Repenting, hope of forgiveness and covering a sin; not legal punishment (see hudud).

situations.title: Temptation and Desire
situations.description: Lowering the gaze, being alone with the opposite sex, lust, and asking for steadiness; not worldly wealth (see detachment-from-world) or marriage law (see proposal-and-consent).

situations.title: Doubts and Whispers (Waswasa)
situations.description: Whispers from Satan in faith, prayer or purity, including doubt about whether wudu is still valid; not hypocrisy (see hypocrisy-and-apostasy).

situations.title: When You Have Missed a Prayer
situations.description: What to do after sleeping through or forgetting an obligatory prayer; not ordinary prayer times (see prayer-times).

situations.title: Bad Dreams
situations.description: What to do after a bad dream; not interpreting good dreams (see dreams-and-visions).

situations.title: Bedtime and Restless Nights
situations.description: What to say and do at bedtime, on waking at night, and when fearful at night; not night prayer (see night-prayer).

situations.title: When Someone Wrongs You
situations.description: Someone personally harmed, cheated, slandered or betrayed you; not discrimination or unequal treatment (see facing-discrimination, facing-inequality).

situations.title: Falling Out with Someone
situations.description: Quarrels, cutting off for more than three days, family rifts and making peace; not war (see peace-treaties).

situations.title: Making a Decision
situations.description: Istikharah and consultation before a choice; not voluntary prayers in general (see voluntary-prayers).

situations.title: Feeling Envied or Envious
situations.description: Envy in oneself and protection from the evil eye; not magic in general (see ruqyah-and-evil-eye).

situations.title: Good News, Wealth and Blessings
situations.description: Gratitude, prostration of thanks, congratulating, and how to receive wealth or praise; not ordinary dhikr (see remembrance).

situations.title: Rain, Wind and Drought
situations.description: What to say in wind, rain, thunder and drought; not the formal rain prayer (see rain-prayer).

situations.title: When You Become Muslim
situations.description: The first steps after accepting Islam: ghusl, what is forgiven and what a new Muslim must do; not the pillars in general (see pillars-of-faith).

situations.title: Facing Discrimination
situations.description: Treated as lesser because of race, colour, origin, gender, poverty or status.

situations.title: Facing Inequality and Unfairness
situations.description: Denied a fair share or rights, favouritism, an unjust system or employer.

situations.title: Feeling Sad or Low
situations.description: Sadness, heaviness of heart or depression without a specific loss; not grief after a death (see grief-and-loss).

situations.title: Feeling Lonely
situations.description: Isolation, being a stranger, having no one.

situations.title: Feeling Hopeless
situations.description: Despairing of Allah's mercy, of change, or of oneself.

situations.title: Weak Faith or Laziness in Worship
situations.description: Faith feels weak, prayer feels heavy, struggling to worship.

situations.title: Struggling With a Bad Habit
situations.description: A sin or habit one keeps returning to and wants to break.

situations.title: Holding a Grudge
situations.description: Resentment, hatred or a grudge in the heart toward someone.

situations.title: Being Insulted or Mocked
situations.description: Someone insults, curses or ridicules you.

situations.title: You Hurt Someone
situations.description: You wronged or hurt someone and want to make amends and seek their pardon.

situations.title: Trouble With Parents
situations.description: Disagreement, strain or harshness between you and your parents.

situations.title: Trouble With Relatives
situations.description: Family quarrels, broken ties with siblings or relatives.

situations.title: Going Through Divorce
situations.description: Facing or living through a divorce or separation.

situations.title: Pregnancy and Childbirth
situations.description: Expecting a child, labour, the newly delivered mother.

situations.title: Longing for Children
situations.description: Unable to have children or waiting for a child.

situations.title: Losing a Child
situations.description: A child or baby has died, including miscarriage.

situations.title: Growing Old
situations.description: Old age, weakness and its reward.

situations.title: Living With Disability or Long Illness
situations.description: Blindness, disability or an illness that lasts.

situations.title: Caring for Someone Sick
situations.description: Looking after a sick relative or friend.

situations.title: Lost Money or Work
situations.description: Lost a job, business, property or savings.

situations.title: Starting Work or a Business
situations.description: A new job, trade or venture, seeking lawful provision.

situations.title: Studying and Learning
situations.description: Student life, exams, seeking knowledge.

situations.title: In a Position of Authority
situations.description: You lead, manage, judge or are responsible for others.

situations.title: Problems at Work
situations.description: Trouble with an employer, employee, colleague or wages.

situations.title: Living Among Non-Muslims
situations.description: Muslim minority life, non-Muslim family, neighbours or colleagues.

situations.title: Persecuted for Your Faith
situations.description: Harmed, mocked or pressured for being Muslim.

situations.title: Under Unjust Rulers
situations.description: Living under oppressive or corrupt authority.

situations.title: Epidemic or Plague
situations.description: Contagious disease spreading in your land.

situations.title: Disaster and Calamity in the Land
situations.description: Earthquake, flood, storm, drought or famine.

situations.title: Being Praised
situations.description: People praise you or you are tempted by fame.

situations.title: Advising Someone
situations.description: You need to advise, correct or warn someone.

situations.title: Wanting to Marry
situations.description: Wishing to marry but unable or still searching, and staying chaste meanwhile; not the wedding itself (see getting-married).
